case.summary: Online transaction 3478782 for $292.36 on card C11891-K1 was flagged on 2016-11-22 17:27:07 with a model risk score of 0.79 because the amount was 6.2x the card's median spend of $47.29. The evidence rests on the transaction utilizing an established device profile and billing region for this card, alongside simulated customer validation confirming the purchase. The investigation concluded the activity is legitimate, representing unusual but genuine cardholder behavior, with a fraud probability of 0.02. It remains uncertain whether the cardholder directly validated the charge, as no real response was available and the confirmation relies on a simulated response.
